Proof in the paper: No peak related to Au (2θ = 38, 44, and 70°), Pd (2θ = 40, 49, and 67°), or PdO (2θ = 34°) is observed, indicating no phase segregation. Instead, a broad diffraction peak appears at 2θ = 39° (between the expected Au and Pd reflections) in catalysts prepared with acid, corresponding to an AuPd alloy phase. (Section: Discussion)
